actions.action: Move the plant away from radiators and heaters to a cooler spot
Water only the soil or bottom-water instead of misting
Empty the saucer 15-20 minutes after watering
Check that the top layer of soil has dried slightly before watering again
Remove dead flowers at the base, plus yellowing or damaged leaves
Place in bright indirect light or a lightly shaded spot outside, avoiding afternoon sun
If she recovers, plant in a shady, moist garden spot after the frosts end

reason: The answer treats the healthy plant as stressed by heat, misting and watering, mentioning natural flower fading only as a side note; the deadheading fix is buried among other care steps, but none of the advice is likely to harm the plant.
